description: This file defines data types, constants, and functions related to admin and management data for users, departments, teams, activities, and certificates within an LMS system.

methods.name: getUsersByRole
methods.description: Returns a list of platform users filtered by their role.

methods.name: getUsersByManager
methods.description: Returns a list of learner users managed by a specific manager.

methods.name: getDepartmentById
methods.description: Retrieves a department object by its ID.

methods.name: getTeamById
methods.description: Retrieves a team object by its ID.

methods.name: getUserById
methods.description: Finds a user by their ID.

methods.name: getManagerTeamIds
methods.description: Returns the list of team IDs managed by a specific manager.

methods.name: getLearnersForManager
methods.description: Returns learners associated with the teams managed by a specific manager.
